title: CI speed: remove the O(files x stems) hot loop in check_unwired_artifacts.scan, then the live-queue test recomputation
note: [2026-10-26 lane] MEASURED by manager: pytest-run 14.4 min (10-13) -> 28-39; slowest test test_phase_g_sunset_and_pull sunset_pass self-test 259.5 s, 257 of it in check_unwired_artifacts.scan. FIX 1 (this PR): scan() compiles the same pattern per file over only stems present as tokens. MEASURED: full tree 1333 targets old 96.3 s -> new 12.4 s with byte-identical findings (191); sunset_pass --self-test now 23.8 s. FIX 2 (next PR): live-queue tests re-running dispatcher/parser; no skips/weakened asserts. Closes when pytest-run p50 is observed back under ~15 min. [2026-10-26 lane close] Fix 1 #20373 MERGED 16:57Z, Fix 2 #20374 MERGED 16:38Z (merged, not yet observed). Fix 2 MEASURED: dispatch_queue dry run over 1,075 units 26.8 s -> 1.8 s; w4 dispatcher tests ~60 s -> ~7 s each. NOT DONE (still slow, unprofiled, no skips/weakened asserts allowed): test_attention_watch (109 s, 55 s), test_render_daily_brief (4 x ~37 s), test_research_queue_autonomy every_template (32 s) + self_tests (28 s), test_candle_fixture_non_degeneracy (100 s per manager), test_collapsed_state_guard_evidence (71 s). PR #20373 pytest-run took 39.8 min on a saturated runner pool before Fix 2 was on main. CLOSES (-> done) when a pytest-run on main after 16:57Z is observed and its p50 over the next ~10 runs is under ~15 min; otherwise file the remaining tests as a Fix 3 lane.

observation.what: pytest-run p50 over the 10 PR runs after 2026-10-26T16:57Z is under ~15 min (was 28-39 min)
